notes.title: Update for all you Hexagroovers out there!
notes.notes:
We've now added an achievement feature to help you track it all in-game!

Also as the busy little worker bees we are we have polished the UI in multiple places.

Happy DJing this weekend!

notes.title: Demo update before tomorrows launch!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38797105/30915c6ef22dc9c6e87151cc361e9f9b311d08db.jpgHey Hexapeople, another update before the launch tomorrow October 27th!

We updated the demo with another fix, we added the Lead 2 instrument so players can get a deeper taste of the music before purchase.  Due to popular demand we have now also changed the demo level to include our Synthwave level rather than the Chiprock level.

Don't feel like the House and Synthwave level is enough? Join us for the stream where we will be showing you guys multiple venues and modes!

notes.title: Demo Hotfix October 16
notes.notes:
Hey Hexa-people!

Just giving a heads up that we now have fixed the following issues:


 The help screen sometimes randomly disappeared, should now only disappear when you want it to.
 The key mapping for the Switch Pro Controller should now should the correct buttons.
 Sometimes the game would crash if you were using a mono sound card, should no longer be the case.


Happy DJing!
